Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Set Up Players take turns first placing their bungalow then their 6 trailers. Bungalows may not be placed immediately next to the pool or next to the another player's bungalow. A fence will be placed automatically between the two pieces if a trailer is placed orthogonally adjacent to another player's piece. The three mystery tokens (2 ice creams and 1 pain in the neck guy) will be revealed. Game Play 1. Movements - players have a total 2 movements divided between trailers or pain in the neck guy. Fences will be placed automatically when your trailer is moved immediately next to your opponent's bungalow or trailer. 2. Add a fence - you can add a fence anywhere in the playground. Game End & Scoring Game ends when each section only contains one player's piece. Player score each square in their areas. Ice cream = +5 points if in your area Pain in the neck guy = -10 points, min 0 Pool = number of squares in your area x 2 Board Game Arena would like to thank Asmodee for making it possible to have this game here. 2748 deluxecamping العربية беларуская мова български език Brezhoneg Català čeština Dansk Deutsch Ελληνικά English Español Eesti keel فارسی Suomi Français Galego עברית Hrvatski Magyar Italiano Bahasa Indonesia 日本語 한국어 Lietuvių Latviešu Bahasa Malaysia Nederlands Norsk Polski Português Română Русский язык Slovenčina Slovenščina Српски Svenska ไทย Türkçe Українська мова Tiếng Việt 中文 (漢) 中文 (汉) Application loading... ... {DISPLAY_IN_OTHER_LANG} {LANG_REDIRECT_CODE} boardgamearena.com Top Help What is Board Game Arena? [Rating: 2/10] Played with 3. The rules didn't seem to make sense. Being the first in turn order pretty much wrapped up the game for me from the very first round. There wasn't any challenge at all. No English rules were available at the time, so it could have been a bad translation.

[Rating: 3/10] Dont' play it with 4 players. Perhaps it's better with less players but I prefer Terra Nova!

[Rating: 3/10] Very basic area enclosure game that doesn't do anything special. Instead it came out many years after "Through the Desert" and others, that are vastly better in pretty much every aspect.

[Rating: 4/10] Played once (with 4 players). It is likely to be better with fewer players. Initial placement is definitely a key to not being unable to play after one or two turns. Our game was much too short to be interesting - but did not leave us eager to play a rematch.

[Rating: 4/10] I enjoy the theme, and the components are nice.  However, this comes at a price, and even at half the cost, I would hesitate to buy this.  The gameplay is kind of humorous, but not terribly engaging.  Maybe it's too abstract, but I just don't get very excited while playing.

[Rating: 5/10] jeu abstrait de placement de barrieres. le theme le rend rigolo, mais pas interessant pour autant.

[Rating: 5/10] Items can be blocked into single squares too easily. Less interaction then you would hope. Worth a try, but I was disappointed, however I only played once so far.

[Rating: 5/10] Only one game with 3 players. I guess I'll like it much better with only two players.

[Rating: 5/10] [FR] Totalement chaotique à 4 joueurs, Deluxe Camping est cependant très calculatoire et intéressant à 2, qui restera certainement le meilleur format. Le thème du camping est ici très bien retranscrit, on retrouve tous les ingrédients d'une bonne semaine sous la tente, à éviter les voisins chieurs, à scouater le glacier et à se prélasser les pieds dans la piscine. Sous un thème léger, Deluxe Camping est plaisant.
